mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.citation_id AS "citationId", c.source_id AS "sourceId", c.version AS "version", c.anchor_id AS "anchorId", c.label AS "label", c.source_type AS "sourceType", c.content_sha256 AS "citationSha256", a.kind AS "anchorKind", a.ordinal AS "anchorOrdinal", a.content_sha256 AS "anchorSha256", a.locator_json AS "locatorJson", a.text AS "anchorText", v.body_markdown AS "bodyMarkdown", v.file_ref AS "fileRef", v.answer_state AS "answerState", v.created_at AS "sourceVersionCreatedAt", s.current_version AS "currentVersion", s.created_at AS "sourceCreatedAt", CASE WHEN s.type = 'NOTE' THEN nv.title ELSE s.title END AS "sourceTitle" FROM ma_citation c JOIN ma_result r ON r.result_id = c.result_id AND r.status = 'VERIFIED' JOIN ma_run run ON run.run_id = r.run_id AND run.status = 'SUCCEEDED' JOIN ma_request req ON req.request_id = run.request_id AND req.account_id = run.account_id JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = c.source_id AND s.account_id = req.account_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.type = c.source_type JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = c.source_id AND v.version = c.version AND v.status != 'WITHDRAWN' JOIN ma_anchor a ON a.anchor_id = c.anchor_id AND a.source_id = c.source_id AND a.version = c.version AND a.content_sha256 = c.content_sha256 LEFT JOIN ma_note_version nv ON nv.source_id = v.source_id AND nv.version = v.version AND s.type = 'NOTE' WHERE c.citation_id = #{citationId} AND run.account_id = #{accountId} AND req.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.account_id = #{accountId} AND ((s.type = 'TUTOR_SNAPSHOT' AND req.snapshot_source_id = c.source_id AND req.snapshot_version = c.version AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_evidence e WHERE e.run_id = run.run_id AND e.source_id = c.source_id AND e.version = c.version AND e.anchor_id = c.anchor_id AND e.type = 'CURRENT_SNAPSHOT')) OR (s.type != 'TUTOR_SNAPSHOT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_evidence e WHERE e.run_id = run.run_id AND e.source_id = c.source_id AND e.version = c.version AND e.anchor_id = c.anchor_id AND e.type = 'HISTORY')))
